parameters.name: CatalogName
parameters.description: The name of the data catalog.

parameters.name: DataRegion
parameters.description: The region where the data lake resides.

parameters.name: FunctionNamePattern
parameters.description: A regular expression used to filter function names.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. If the response to a previous request is truncated, you can use this token to retrieve the next page of results.

- If **NextToken** is empty, there is no next query.

- If a value is returned for **NextToken**, that value is the token for the next query.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
The tenant ID.

> To view the tenant ID, hover over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see [View tenant information](~~181330~~).
